personality_one_liner: A highly polished, trustworthy dark-mode finance tracker using deep slate and crisp emerald green, emphasizing clarity and typographic hierarchy.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for amounts and lists. Tightly coupled groups for settings and forms.

do's: Sticky 'Total Spend' header over home feed
Paywall Pro section overlay (blurring locked charts)
Bottom-sheet handles and form sticky buttons

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.layout: Full-bleed background scenes (using subtle gradients and app mockups), bottom 1/3 for text. Pagination dots. Primary CTA 'Get Started' sticky above safe area.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Show big total spend number and list subscriptions by renewal date.

states.loading: Skeleton rows mapping the subscription list.
states.empty: Illustration of empty wallet + 'No subscriptions added yet' + 'Add Subscription' primary CTA.
states.error: Failed to load data + Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky large header at the top displaying total spend in Space Grotesk (e.g. '$124.99 / mo'). Below, a vertically scrolling list of cards/rows. Each row has a leading image (logo), title, subtitle (billing cycle), trailing cost, and a brandTertiary chip for 'Days left'.

screens.name: Add Subscription Grid
screens.purpose: Quickly add popular services via preset grid.
screens.layout: Search bar at top. 3-column grid (`flexWrap: 'wrap', justifyContent: 'space-between'`) for popular services. Each tile uses `surfaceSecondary`, `md` padding, a 36x36px logo, and brand name. Custom add button at the end.

screens.name: Add/Edit Form
screens.purpose: Input cost, billing cycle, category, and date.
screens.layout: Single column form. Labels above inputs. Segmented control (`surfaceTertiary` background, `surfaceSecondary` active toggle) for Weekly/Monthly/Yearly. Primary 'Save' CTA sticky at bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Insights & Paywall Preview
screens.purpose: Display category breakdown and tease pro features.

states.empty: No data pie chart (greyed out) + 'Add subs to see insights'.

screens.layout: Top half: Category Pie Chart with legends. Bottom half: 6-month trend line chart. Pro Paywall overlay: A frosted glass absolute view covering the bottom half, blurring the line chart. Centered 'Upgrade to Pro' button and lock icon.

screens.name: Paywall Modal
screens.purpose: Convert free users to Pro with plan comparisons.
screens.layout: Full-screen modal. Blurred dark chart background image with strong top-to-bottom vertical gradient scrim (transparent to #09090B at 70%). High-contrast title. Bullet-point feature list with emerald checks. Plan selection cards (Annual highlighted with emerald border). Sticky 'Get Pro' CTA.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly avoid any blue or purple tones. Use only the defined Emerald Green (brandPrimary #10B981) for accents.
Implement the gradient scrim pattern (transparent to 70%+ #09090B) over the Paywall Background image before placing any text on it.

For the preset subscription grid, attempt to render the actual logos provided in the images object. For any missing logos (like ChatGPT), fallback to a brandTertiary-tinted circle containing the service initials (e.g. 'CG').
Use Space Grotesk exclusively for large numeric data (total spend, prices, charts) and Plus Jakarta Sans for all other text.
Ensure 'Save' and 'Get Pro' buttons remain sticky above the keyboard/home indicator, keeping scrollable content behind them.
The Insights Pro-locked section must use the glassmorphism approach: blur the underlying charts and use an absolute positioned view with the CTA to tease the content underneath.
